name: Resell Pro
description:
5:42 PM






Resell Pro helps Vinted resellers research the market and make informed sourcing and pricing decisions using observed sales data.
Get a market overview, compare brands, explore specific niches, and discover emerging trends. Analyze patterns across countries, categories, and time periods to understand demand and compare opportunities relevant to your business.
Whether you are exploring a new category or refining your sourcing strategy, Resell Pro brings market insights into your conversation. Ask questions in plain language and use the results to guide further research.
All tools are read-only. Results reflect tracked Vinted observations rather than complete marketplace coverage, and do not guarantee future sales or profitability.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Resell Pro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Resell Pro to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://resellpro.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Resell Pro MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resell Pro provides these MCP tools: analyze_market_segment, compare_brands, discover_market_trends, and marketplace_overview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Resell Pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Resell Pro in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Resell Pro MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resell Pro requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Resell Pro is developed by Resell Pro. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
